studies.Title: Variation of urinary and serum trace elements (Ca, Zn, Cu, Se) in bladder carcinoma in China.
studies.Reference: Variation of urinary and serum trace elements (Ca, Zn, Cu, Se) in bladder carcinoma in China.
studies.Journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
studies.Population: Patients with bladder carcinoma and healthy persons in China
studies.comparison_type: cases versus healthy controls (serum and urinary copper levels)

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: To determine this, 81 patients with bladder carcinoma chosen as a study group and 130 healthy persons chosen as a control group were all assayed for urinary and serum trace elements (calcium [Ca], zinc [Zn], copper [Cu], selenium [Se]) using an atomic absorption spectrophotometer, and the results were analyzed by independent sample t tests.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: Since there are few studies of the effect of trace elements in bladder carcinoma in China, the aim of this study was thus to assess variation using a case control approach. To determine this, 81 patients with bladder carcinoma chosen as a study group and 130 healthy persons chosen as a control group were all assayed for urinary and serum trace elements (calcium [Ca], zinc [Zn], copper [Cu], selenium [Se]) using an atomic absorption spectrophotometer, and the results were analyzed by independent sample t tests.
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: There were higher urinary Zn and serum Cu concentrations in bladder carcinoma cases.
extraction_supporting_text.design: the aim of this study was thus to assess variation using a case control approach
